title: Development of a primary structure concept for a jet propelled high altitude research aircraft.
author: André Gerard Radtke
abstract: The objective of this work is to define a structural layout for a high altitude research aircraft, which resembles a high performance sailplane. In order to conceive the structure elements an initial study of loading cases for the major components is conducted. Through the use of parametric modeling and analytic methods, software routines are created to compute strains, stresses, divergence and other driving design criteria which affect high aspect ratio wings. The results computed, supported by the traditional construction methods, allow for a feasible layout suggestion.
